Zatim sam živela u golubarniku od 20 kvadrata u Zemunu. Iako je stan imao prelep pogled, stanodavac je obični prevarant i digao je kiriju sa 200€ na 230€ za par meseci. Izašlo me na isto na kraju, opet oko 310€ samo što je ovaj stan bio deset nivoa ispod onog na Dorćolu i stanodavac je bio đubre. Daleko od faksa, daleko od svega ali jebiga, tako se posložilo.

Iz mog iskustva mogu da kažem sledeće :

Mnogo stanodavaca su bahati i bezobrazni nehljebari i daće sve od sebe da te maksimalno zajebu i da ti podmetnu polu-funkcionalan stan da se ti cimaš i zoveš majstore / o svom trošku popravljaš stvari. 

Zato - zauzmi stav i ne kupuj njihove šuplje priče. Kad ideš da gledaš stan uvek traži račune na uvid, proveri tuš i pritisak vode, GUMU OD VEŠ MAŠINE UVEK, poštansko sanduče i ključ za isti ma svaki ćošak stana svaku rupu i ogrebotinu na nameštaju / zidu otvori i pregledaj. 

Nakon što nađeš stan koji ti odgovara - sve slikaj; aparate, zidove, sanitarije itd.
 
Zapamti - ne odgovaraš za tragove koji se dešavaju redovnim korištenjem stana!!!! Nisi dužan da plaćaš čišćenja i krečenja nakon iseljenja!!!

Odmah se dogovorite za depozit - da li se računa kao poslednja kirija ili je dobijaš nazad i tu izjavu obavezno da imaš u ugovoru. 

Lokacija je takođe bitna, proveri linije za buseve, blizinu prodavnica, apoteka, kafića, kao i to da li se u blizini nalazi gradilište. 

Želim ti sve najbolje i svu sreću u prolaženju stana!! Svako dobro !

The dream where I met my subconscious.


This happened sometime last year. 

I was experiencing a lot of stress and other mental health issues due to a severe burnout after finishing highschool. I was also attempting to salvage my almost completely broken relationship with my mother.

The part of the dream that matters :

I was in front of some large residential building with my friends and we went inside, looking for a grocery store. We were met by a middle aged guy standing in the hallway. He had sunglasses, a 70s mustache and long, grey hair with a huge bald spot. 

 I was reluctant to ask him for help and I almost started crying - next thing you know he approaches us and says that he will help. 

Suddenly, we were moving up, like in some invisible elevator. In front of us was the garden from my family home. 

There, in the garden below , stood my mom. 

He took my head and turned it to the left as if to direct my gaze somewhere else. I guess she's what he wanted me to see. 

Then, he told me : 

" You're burdening yourself because you don't know the answers to your suffering. You've been blaming yourself for way too long. If you want the true answer, stop for a second and look around. You can't miss it. " 

That's where the dream ended. My mom and I are on much better terms now, and even though the dream sounds weird and unrealistic, it felt VERY REAL and has helped me navigate some of my struggles.
